}}'''Charn''' was a pikeman who fought alongside [[Juilin Sandar]] and [[Myk]] against the [[Sharan]]s in the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|37}} He tried to help Juilin when the latter lost his spear against a mace-wielding Sharan. The Sharan split his head "like a cracked walnut" with a mace.
